page_note: Page is dominated by a Manichaean ecclesial chapter on Elect fasting (segments 9-34). The chapter uses a four-fold enumeration that LOOKS substratic but applies the pattern to institutional fasting practice ('the holy ones', 'the faithful'). Editorial fatigue score +22.7 in ecclesial vocabulary confirms heavy late layering. Some genuine substrate cosmology surfaces in the four works (soul/mingling/darkness/Living Soul) but it is wrapped in the ecclesial frame. The opening segments (0-7) preserve fragments of substrate dualistic teaching (separation of Light/Darkness, Beautiful/Bad) within a hortatory closing of the previous chapter. Heavy lacunae (77%) limit certainty.
